scope: Post-evaluation development replay of a coarse-guide identity guard; no held-out improvement claim.

method.semantics: A uniquely reconstructed physical line must also remain inside the coarse target guide band. Ambiguous geometry stays ambiguous.

hypotheses: A tolerance equal to one quarter of the observation search half-width rejects grossly displaced real lines without pretending the guide is exact geometry.
The guard will not resolve a surface stripe that still lies inside the coarse guide band.
Because these source cases were already inspected, every result is a development regression and not a blind evaluation.
